delivery.qaSummary: 以管理员账号登录后完成 B01-B05 全部浏览器验收：新增客户“验收新增客户A”及联系人并刷新确认关联；为该客户新增金额 100 商机，客户详情商机列表与合计显示真实记录 100.00；将商机阶段改为赢单后按 Won 筛选命中、按 Lost 筛选不混入；金额改为 150 刷新后合计增加 50 至 150.00；缺必填客户与负金额均显示可理解错误且未落库。控制台与页面错误为空，未出现 Something went wrong 或非预期 4xx/5xx。

checks.title: 新增客户及其联系人，刷新客户详情，联系人仍关联到正确客户。
checks.criterion: 新增客户及其联系人，刷新客户详情，联系人仍关联到正确客户。
actions: 以管理员 nocobase 登录后进入 Customers，点击 New customer，填写名称“验收新增客户A”、行业“智能制造”，提交，列表出现该客户（/main/customers/3）。
进入 Contacts -> New contact，填写联系人“验收联系人甲”、联系方式 13800001111，在 Customer 下拉中选择“验收新增客户A”，提交，联系人列表显示该联系人的客户为“验收新增客户A”。
打开客户“验收新增客户A”详情，浏览器 reload 刷新后重新读取页面。
evidence: 刷新后客户详情仍显示 Contacts 区域包含“验收联系人甲 / 13800001111”，且 Opportunities 区域显示 This customer has no opportunities，说明联系人确实关联到该客户。
刷新前与刷新后两次读取结果一致，关联未丢失。
页面未出现 Something went wrong、空白页或非预期 4xx/5xx。
checks.result: 页面未出现 Something went wrong、空白页或非预期 4xx/5xx。

actions: 进入 Opportunities -> New opportunity，填写商机名称“验收商机A”，Customer 选择“验收新增客户A”，Estimated amount 填 100，Stage 默认 Following，提交。

合计金额等于该记录金额，而非固定演示值（新增前该客户无商机，总额从空变为 100.00）。
checks.result: 合计金额等于该记录金额，而非固定演示值（新增前该客户无商机，总额从空变为 100.00）。

checks.criterion: 将该商机阶段改为“赢单”，按阶段筛选能正确找到；另一阶段筛选不混入它。
actions: 在 Opportunities 列表点击“验收商机A”的 Edit，编辑表单回填名称“验收商机A”、客户“验收新增客户A”、金额 100、阶段 Following。
将 Stage 由 Following 改为 Won（对应“赢单”），保存，列表显示“验收商机A / Won”。
使用阶段筛选下拉选择 Won，检查列表；再选择 Lost，检查列表。
evidence: 筛选 Won 后 URL 变为 /main/opportunities?stage=won，列表包含“验收商机A / 验收新增客户A / 100.00 / Won”。
筛选 Lost 后 URL 变为 /main/opportunities?stage=lost，列表只有“年度采购框架”，不含“验收商机A”，证明另一阶段筛选未混入。

rawRetro.summary: Implemented the simplified CRM (customers, contacts, opportunities) with a self-contained migration, an idempotent seed of 2/3/3 sample records, authenticated /api/crm routes, a service provider, three bilingual list pages with create/edit dialogs, a customer detail with contacts/opportunities and a real-record amount total, and an opportunity stage filter. Added migration/seed/service and route auth/validation tests; updated the two route-composition tests. All targeted lint, format, typecheck, test (398) and build checks pass.

blockers.title: Prettier and ESLint quote rules reject freshly added shadcn/ui files
blockers.symptom: `pnpm lint` reported ~75 `quotes`/`jsx-quotes` errors in client/components/ui/{table,card,badge,textarea}.tsx, and prettier --check flagged the new seed file.
blockers.rootCause: The shadcn CLI writes double-quoted TS/JSX while the repo's `@nocobase/dev-config` rules require single quotes; the seed was written without running the repo formatter.
blockers.resolution: Ran prettier --write on the generated ui files and the seed, and removed the unused `badgeVariants` export so the badge file only exports a component (react-refresh).

improvements.title: client:inspect tsx test breaks once dist/ exists
improvements.detail: `tests/logic/inspect-client.test.ts` spawns `pnpm exec tsx ./cli/index.ts app inspect client ... --json` and parses stdout directly. When `dist/package.json` exists, pnpm's verify-deps-before-run step prints "Already up to date\nDone in ..." to stdout ahead of the JSON, so JSON.parse throws. It reproduces after any `pnpm build` and disappears when dist is removed.
improvements.suggestedChange: In the test's child stdout handler, drop pnpm install-banner lines (or set `npm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false` for the child) before JSON.parse, so running tests after a local build does not fail on unrelated pnpm output.
